SHIPPING_POLICY:
Shipping and digital delivery

Updated October 7, 2026. Contact 3000 Studios at mr.jwswain@gmail.com with your order number.

Digital products

Digital products do not require shipping. Download access is provided after successful payment through the digital-delivery email and supported order download links. If your email or file is missing, contact us so we can restore access.

Physical order processing

For an in-stock item with confirmed supplier availability, our target is 1–2 business days to process the order. Made-to-order and print-on-demand merchandise requires production before dispatch; allow approximately 2–7 business days, or the longer item-specific estimate shown before purchase. Weekends and public holidays are excluded. Do not assume that processing and transit are the same period.

Transit estimates

Where the selected supplier supports these services, US-warehouse shipping is estimated at 5–10 business days after dispatch and standard shipping at 10–20 business days after dispatch. The product-specific delivery estimate and available destinations shown before purchase take precedence, especially where a supplier requires longer. We do not promise a faster service than the selected supplier can provide. Carriers and fulfillment warehouses vary, and items may arrive separately. Shipping charges and available services are shown at checkout.

Tracking and delays

We aim to email tracking within 24 hours after fulfillment, once the carrier or fulfillment partner supplies it. Carrier updates may take time to appear. If we cannot ship within the promised processing period, we will notify you of the revised date and offer the choice to consent to the delay or cancel for a full refund, as required by applicable law. Contact us promptly about incorrect addresses, lost deliveries or damage. Customs charges, where applicable, are disclosed by the carrier or destination authorities.
REFUND_POLICY:
Returns and refunds

Updated October 7, 2026. Start a return by emailing mr.jwswain@gmail.com with your order number, the item and the reason for the request. Please wait for return instructions; do not send goods to an unconfirmed address.

Physical products: 30-day returns

You may request a return within 30 days after delivery. For a change-of-mind return, the item must be unused, unworn, in its original condition and packaging, with proof of purchase. We will confirm the return destination and any applicable return-shipping cost before you send it. Unless the item is damaged, defective or incorrect, return shipping is the customer's responsibility. This policy applies to physical merchandise sold by this store, including made-to-order merchandise, unless a legally permitted exception was clearly disclosed before purchase.

Damaged, defective or wrong items

Contact us with your order number and, where practical, photos of the problem. We will offer a replacement or a full refund for a confirmed damaged, defective or incorrect item. You do not need to pay return shipping for these cases; we do not require the item to be returned unless we provide a prepaid return arrangement.

Digital downloads and services

Digital downloads are final sale after delivery or access, except where applicable law provides otherwise. If a file is missing, corrupted, incorrect or cannot be accessed, we will help restore access or supply a working replacement. If we cannot resolve the issue, we will refund the affected digital purchase. Custom music services follow any written scope agreed before work begins; contact us before purchase if you need cancellation terms clarified.

Refund timing

After approving a refund, we issue it to the original payment method. Allow approximately 5–10 business days for the payment provider to post it; bank processing can vary. We will tell you if a return is declined and why. Nothing in this policy removes nonwaivable rights relating to defective goods, cancellation, warranties or refunds under applicable law.

PRIVACY_POLICY:
Privacy policy

Updated October 7, 2026. This policy explains how 3000 Studios uses information when you visit boughtitonline.com or purchase from us. To request help or exercise privacy rights, email mr.jwswain@gmail.com.

Information collected and purposes

We collect the information you provide for a purchase, account, support request or newsletter: name, email, billing and shipping address, order details and correspondence. The storefront also uses device, browser, IP-address, cookie and usage information for security, checkout operation, analytics and, where enabled and permitted, marketing. We use this information to process payments, deliver digital files, fulfill physical orders, provide support, prevent fraud, meet legal obligations and send marketing only where appropriate consent or another lawful basis applies.

Payments and fulfillment providers

Payments are handled by Shopify and its payment processors. We do not receive your full payment-card number or security code; order records can include payment status, card brand and limited payment identifiers. We share information needed to operate the store with Shopify, payment processors, digital-delivery services and support providers. Physical fulfillment requires sharing the shipping name, address and necessary contact/order details with fulfillment suppliers, print-on-demand partners and carriers. Providers process information under their applicable terms and privacy policies.

Cookies, analytics and marketing choices

Essential cookies support checkout, security and your cart. Analytics or advertising technologies, when enabled, may require consent depending on your location. Use the store's privacy controls and Your Privacy Choices page to manage available preferences. We do not sell personal information for money. Certain advertising or analytics disclosures can be considered a sale or sharing under state law; where applicable, you can opt out and use recognized browser privacy signals. Newsletter emails include an unsubscribe link; unsubscribing does not stop essential order or support emails.

Retention and protection

We retain information only as needed for orders, support, fraud prevention, legal recordkeeping and permitted business purposes. Retention depends on the record and legal obligation. We use reasonable safeguards and restrict access to necessary providers and authorized personnel, but no system can guarantee absolute security. Store providers may process information in countries other than your own.

Your rights

Depending on your location and the laws that apply to this business, you may request access, correction, deletion, portability, or limits on processing, and opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information. California residents may have rights to know, delete, correct, opt out, limit certain uses of sensitive information and receive equal service without unlawful discrimination. We will verify requests proportionately and respond within applicable deadlines; legal recordkeeping and other lawful exceptions may limit deletion. An authorized agent may contact us, subject to appropriate verification. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

Updates

We may update this policy when the store or its providers change. The effective date above identifies the latest version. Contact us if a privacy control does not work or you need another way to submit a request.
